Drishyam 3 Surpasses ₹300 Crore at Box Office

The film Drishyam 3 has surpassed ₹300 crore at the box office, marking a career-best for actor Ajay Devgn. On its 10th day, the film's worldwide total continued its strong run. Drishyam 3 has also neared ₹5 billion worldwide, becoming the second-highest-grossing Indian film of 2026. Another film, Hanuman Ansh, has earned ₹435.37 crore worldwide but is trailing Drishyam 3 by ₹44 crore.
